firewalled_field_flags.issue: The guide's CRAC field dictionary uses `compressor_state` (on/off/standby), `unit_state` (online/standby) and `supply_temp_c`. This SPL tests `compressor_status!="normal"` and `unit_status!="running"` on `bms:crac`, so values may never equal 'normal' or 'running' and every unit, including healthy standby units, would alert. Verify field names and value sets.
The title covers CRAH (chilled-water) units, which have no compressor, but the condition is built on compressor status.

summary: Generic CRAC/CRAH health text. The SPL tests status and compressor fields whose values do not match the guide's CRAC field dictionary, and the troubleshooting boilerplate names unrelated fields.
